question.text: What is the minimum corpus required for any Category III AIF scheme at the date of declaration of First Close?

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI (AIF) Regulations prescribe Rs. 20 crore as the minimum corpus at First Close for any Category III AIF scheme. The Trap: Rs. 10 crore is the minimum sponsor/manager commitment for Cat III (not corpus); Rs. 25 crore is not a corpus threshold. Cross-Exam Context: Same Rs. 20 crore minimum applies to Cat I/II AIFs (XIX-A) — SEBI harmonised the threshold across categories. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Track commitment calendars carefully: if corpus at First Close falls below Rs. 20 crore, the scheme cannot be declared.
